newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Ten raises Television & Media stake.
newsitem.headline: Ten raises Television & Media stake.

text.p: Australian television broadcaster the Ten Group Ltd said on Monday it had raised its stake in Television & Media Services Limited to 10.78 percent from 9.63 percent on May 7.
Canada's CanWest Global Communications Corp holds a 76 percent stake in Ten Group Ltd, but has been ordered by the government to reduce its ownership to 57.5 percent.
Television and Media Services distributes movies, produces videos and operates outdoor advertising.
Television and Media Services said Ten had increased its stake as part of sale and production agreements made in 1995 between Ten and Television and Media Services (TMS).
Under the agreements, Ten was allowed an allotment of up to 1,500,000 ordinary shares if Ten bought services from Television and Media Services worth more than A$1.5 million a year.
Shares in Television and Media Services were unchanged at A$1.10 by early afternoon, while CanWest shares closed at C$20.95 in Toronto on Friday.
